Max learned a lot about math. Mia is interested in reading. Max wrote about the day in the diary. For example, the hospital recorded the baby's birth.
Life is full of small surprises. Max is reading a book about math. Max is going to travel to Tokyo in January. The heady scent of jasmine filled the evening air.
Last Sunday, Max and Mia went to the lantern street. Max spent the weekend at the park. It takes twenty minutes to get to the lantern street by bike. What's more, a savory pancake makes a good lunch.
Max thinks math is interesting but a little difficult. Max and Mia had great fun there. Max hopes to visit Tokyo one day.
